Name: CJB Item Spawner
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: An easy-to-use in-game item spawner menu.
Description:
**CJB Item Spawner** lets you press `i` on your keyboard (configurable) to open a menu to spawn items:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods/master/CJBItemSpawner/docs/screenshot.png)

**Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods#translating-the-mods)).**

## Install
1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2.  Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3.  Run the game using SMAPI.

## How to use
Load your save, then **press the letter `i` on your keyboard** to show the item spawner menu. Change item quality by clicking the `[☆]` quality button at the top.

To change the button:
* On Linux/macOS/Windows, see [key bindings](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings) on the wiki.
* On Android, see [_use key bindings on Android_](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Use_key_bindings_on_Android).

## Troubleshooting
1. This mod isn't part of SMAPI, you need to install it separately. See the install steps above if you didn't do that.
2. Make sure your save is loaded and there's no menu/dialogue open, and then press the letter `i` (not the number `1`).
3. On macOS only, if the menu freezes/lags/crashes the game, [reinstalling Mono](https://www.mono-project.com/download/stable/) usually fixes that. Mono is required by SMAPI on macOS.
4. If it still doesn't work, ask in the comments!

# Compatibility
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, Windows;
  * single-player and multiplayer.
* No known mod conflicts.
